title: How to start your startup journey as a techie. Sharing my story.

blocks.html: After over 15 years in different IT roles and mostly having corporate jobs I decided to build my own startup. Within a year I managed to go from "zero support and no clear plan on how to get there" to becoming a co-founder of a startup that successfully went through 3 acceleration programs and got initial investment. I'd love to share my journey and tips "how to get there" with anyone who wants to start their startup journey as a technical co-founder, especially women!
